reducer_rule: append-only ledger folded to one current row per candidate; the last row for a candidate wins, and a VOID row decides nothing
selection_rule: repository_id in {agent-operator-score, gitseed} AND current adjudication == FUNCTIONALLY_VIOLABLE
why_reuse_is_valid: v5 produced zero product-effect outcomes, so its pre-treatment classification of these decisions is planning input rather than a result. What is reused is the decision's identity, its frozen snapshot and its violability classification; what is not reused is any v5 task, patch, oracle, randomization or row.

candidates.ruling: pin the census ticket-owned path list literally
candidates.reason: every remaining product ticket then needs a census edit, and the deletion it was meant to catch is already caught by the focused-lane count guard

candidates.ruling: keeping one accessor and capping inside it
candidates.reason: it cannot distinguish an observation from a policy, and the version that tried recorded a reset time the server never stated

candidates.ruling: keep the unreachable secondary sort key in reasonsOf
candidates.reason: only two cells can reach UNAVAILABLE in v0 and they carry different reason codes, so the tiebreaker could not be reached and four mutants of it survived

candidates.ruling: verify a wrapper attestation signature
candidates.reason: the SSOT requires none, the signing key had no custody or rotation story, and freezing signatures over fixture content would have made every canonical session permanently unamendable

candidates.ruling: artifact storage port
candidates.reason: pathlib is the only current storage shape and replay does not need another

candidates.ruling: derive factor opportunities from scored observations only
candidates.reason: gate 4 and gate 5 would collapse into each other, since a factor with no scored metric would also have no opportunities, and neither could be tested in isolation

candidates.ruling: JSON files on disk
candidates.reason: SQLite keeps a single durable, constrained run history

candidates.ruling: filtering the roadmap and Board out of a broad input scan
candidates.reason: an exclusion list silently readmits any projection added later, so the input set is declared positively and closed

candidates.ruling: adding coverage gates or a badge
candidates.reason: one workflow that tells the truth is worth more than five nobody reads

candidates.ruling: compile TypeScript to JavaScript before testing so Node 20 can run it
candidates.reason: adds a build step, a devDependency and an emitted-artifact surface to a workspace whose manifest is pinned to name, version and private

candidates.ruling: a separate evidence-kind allowlist
candidates.reason: a literal detached from the producer methods can silently accept evidence no collector emits

candidates.ruling: JSON files on disk
candidates.reason: SQLite provides atomic constraints, version gating, and immutable correction lineage

candidates.ruling: normalized per-port tables
candidates.reason: canonical artifact bytes already preserve the replay contract without duplicating serializers

candidates.ruling: falling back to a zero or midpoint grade when the model misbehaves
candidates.reason: the number would rank a repository on evidence that does not exist, and nothing downstream could tell it from a real grade

candidates.ruling: embed the canonical reports in specs/doctor-output.v0.json
candidates.reason: the ticket grants fixtures/doctor/*.json, and sibling precedent does not override a path the ticket names

candidates.ruling: retrying on a bare 403
candidates.reason: half of them are permissions errors and no amount of waiting fixes those

candidates.ruling: add the two paths to controlPlaneAllowlist
candidates.reason: mislabels product code as control plane and drives control_plane_code_files up as a disguise for a growing product surface

candidates.ruling: every PRD §14 scoring component except commit_cadence_30d, contributor_count, and has_license (the thirty-seven-component remainder across Quality, Momentum, Risk, Novelty, Awareness, Potential, bonuses, penalties, Relevance, and RadarRank)
candidates.reason: M0 measured material contribution only for these three features, so building the remainder would discard the backtest

candidates.ruling: model-assigned categories
candidates.reason: a model opinion cannot manufacture a category assignment

candidates.ruling: remove operational-state-offline in the same edit
candidates.reason: it is legitimately required once its workflow lands, and its absence is a sequencing fact rather than an error in the authority

candidates.ruling: adding a YAML parser to assert workflow shape
candidates.reason: a runtime dependency is forbidden scope for this ticket, so the workflow assertions read the declared shape with anchored matches

candidates.ruling: add a second hardcoded fixture directory beside fixtures/operational-state
candidates.reason: the next ticket needs a third, and a derived rule costs the same once

candidates.ruling: keep the lane counts as a floor
candidates.reason: two cases of slack let whole test cases and five allowlists be removed without a failure

candidates.ruling: a --non-interactive flag for CI
candidates.reason: it would be switched on in CI, and a CI that stars repositories is the automation the AUP forbids

candidates.ruling: letting a grading failure end the run
candidates.reason: it makes one flaky model call discard every candidate already screened

candidates.ruling: leaving the numbers and correcting them during the rebuild
candidates.reason: RED would then fail differently from the ticket contract, which is a hard stop

candidates.ruling: keep the wildcard census and rely on the focused-lane guard
candidates.reason: the guard catches deletion only, and the review demonstrated growth passing 230/230 with an unreviewed product file present

candidates.ruling: hand-maintained product-code allowlist per ticket
candidates.reason: each of the 60 remaining tickets would need a coordinated census amendment, and the list drifts from the tickets it mirrors

candidates.ruling: a pack digest without embedded definitions
candidates.reason: a digest detects change but cannot re-derive a past categorization from its artifact alone

candidates.ruling: pin every prose field by literal digest

candidates.ruling: Add features to raise AUC

candidates.ruling: storage replay as deserialization

candidates.ruling: scoring and screening ports
